identity.name: Ranger
identity.one_liner: A field-watch revival referencing Tudor's Ranger models from the 1960s-80s, using the same 39mm case and movement family as the Black Bay Fifty-Eight but without a rotating dive bezel.

narrative.story: Tudor revived the Ranger name in 2022 after decades away from the catalog, referencing field-watch variants of the Oyster Prince that Tudor sold under the Ranger name from the 1960s into the 1980s. The modern version uses black dial, cream-colored numeral markers, and a riveted-style bracelet or fabric strap rather than the rotating dive bezel Tudor's other Black Bay-family watches carry.
narrative.collector_notes: Because 'Ranger' covered several different vintage case shapes across decades, collectors researching the lineage should check which specific 1960s-70s reference a given comparison is actually citing rather than treat 'Ranger' as one continuous design.
